criterion: 不同目標可得到不同適用結果；未知資料不被猜測；遷移可重跑且衝突可見，舊入口不再判定。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed fact/path-based PC, MCU and RTOS applicability, unknown-fact blocking and repeatable owner-based migration; catalog tests reject stale/missing bindings. Migration is an owner/Skill procedure, not an automatic inference of platform facts.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
